verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu ittaqi Allaaha wa laa tuti'il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeena innallaaha kaana aleeman hakeemaa
Wattabi maa yoohaa ilayka min rabbika innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
Wa tawakkal alaa Allaahi wa kafaa Billaahi wakeelaa

Maa ja'ala Allaahu lirajulin min qalbayni fee jawfihi wa maa ja'ala azwaajakumul-laa'ee tuzaahiroona minhunna ummahaatikum wa maa ja'ala ad'iyaa'akum abnaa'akum dhaalikum qawlukum bi-afwaahikum Wallaahu yaqoolul-haqqa wa huwa yahdis-sabeel

Ud'oohum li-abaa'ihim huwa aqsatu indallaahi fa-in lam ta'lamoo aabaa'ahum fa-ikhwaanukum fid-deeni wa mawaaleekum wa laysa alaykum junaahun feemaa akhta'tum bihi wa laakin maa ta'ammadat quloobukum wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa

An-nabiyyu awlaa bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim wa azwaajuhu ummahaatuhum wa ulul-arhaami ba'duhum awlaa biba'din fee kitaabillaahi minal-mu'mineena wal-muhaajireena illaa an taf'aloo ilaa awliyaa'ikum ma'roofan kaana dhaalika fil-kitaabi mastooraa
Wa idh akhadhnaa minan-nabiyyeena meethaaqahum wa minka wa min noohin wa ibraaheema wa moosaa wa eesab-ni maryama wa akhadhnaa minhum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
Liyas'alas-saadiqeena an sidqihim wa a'adda lilkaafireena adhaaban aleemaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo udhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum idh jaa'atkum junoodun fa-arsalnaa alayhim reehan wa junoodan lam tarawhaa wa kaana Allaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseeraa
Idh jaa'ookum min fawqikum wa min asfala minkum wa idh zaaghatil-absaaru wa balaghatil-quloobul-hanaajira wa tazunnoona Billaahiz-zunoon
Hunaalika ubtuliyal-mu'minoona wa zulziloo zilzaalan shadeedaa
Wa idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun maa wa-adanaa Allaahu wa rasooluhu illaa ghurooraa

Wa idh qaalat taa'ifatun minhum yaa ahla yathriba laa muqaama lakum farji'oo wa yasta'dhinu fareequn minhumun-nabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootanaa awratun wa maa hiya bi-awratin in yureedoona illaa firaaraa
Wa law dukhilat alayhim min aqtaarihaa thumma su'ilul-fitnata la-aatawhaa wa maa talabbathoo bihaa illaa yaseeraa
Wa laqad kaanoo aahadoo Allaaha min qablu laa yuwalloonal-adbaara wa kaana ahdu Allaahi mas'oolaa
Qul lan yanfa'akumul-firaaru in farartum minal-mawti awil-qatli wa idhan laa tumatta'oona illaa qaleelaa
Qul man dhal-ladhee ya'simukum mina Allaahi in araada bikum soo'an aw araada bikum rahmatan wa laa yajidoona lahum min doonillaahi waliyyan wa laa naseeraa
Qad ya'lamu Allaahul-mu'awwiqeena minkum wal-qaa'ileena li-ikhwaanihim halumma ilaynaa wa laa ya'toonal-ba'sa illaa qaleelaa

Ashihhatan alaykum fa-idhaa jaa'al-khawfu ra'aytahum yanzuroona ilayka tadooru a'yunuhum kal-ladhee yughshaa alayhi minal-mawti fa-idhaa dhahabal-khawfu salaqookum bi-alsinatin hidaadin ashihhatan alal-khayri ulaa'ika lam yu'minoo fa-ahbata Allaahu a'maalahum wa kaana dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseeraa
Yahsaboonal-ahzaaba lam yadhhaboo wa in ya'til-ahzaabu yawaddoo law annahum baadoona fil-a'raabi yas'aloona an anbaa'ikum wa law kaanoo feekum maa qaataloo illaa qaleelaa
Laqad kaana lakum fee rasooli Allaahi uswatun hasanatun liman kaana yarjoo Allaaha wal-yawmal-aakhira wa dhakara Allaaha katheeraa
Wa lammaa ra'al-mu'minoonal-ahzaaba qaaloo haadhaa maa wa-adanaa Allaahu wa rasooluhu wa sadaqa Allaahu wa rasooluhu wa maa zaadahum illaa eemaanan wa tasleemaa
Minal-mu'mineena rijaalun sadaqoo maa aahadoo Allaaha alayhi faminhum man qadaa nahbahu wa minhum man yantaziru wa maa baddaloo tabdeelaa
Liyajziya Allaahus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wa yu'adhdhibal-munaafiqeena in shaa'a aw yatooba alayhim innallaaha kaana ghafooran Raheemaa
Waradda Allaahul-ladheena kafaroo bighayzihim lam yanaaloo khayran wa kafaa Allaahul-mu'mineenal-qitaala wa kaana Allaahu qawiyyan azeezaa
Wa anzalal-ladheena zaaharoohum min ahlil-kitaabi min sayaaseehim wa qadhafa fee quloobihimur-ru'ba fareeqan taqtuloona wa ta'siroona fareeqaa
Wa awrathakum ardahum wa diyaarahum wa amwaalahum wa ardan lam tata'oohaa wa kaana Allaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeeraa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'zwaajika in kuntunna turidnal-hayaa itad-dunyaa wa zeenatahaa fata'aalayna umatti'kunna wa usarrihkunna saraahan jameelaa
Wa in kuntunna turidna Allaaha wa rasoolahu wad-daaral-aakhirata fa-innallaaha a'adda lilmuhsinaati minkunna ajran azeemaa
Yaa nisaa'an-nabiyyi man ya'ti minkunna bifaahishatin mubayyinatin yudaa'af lahal-adhaabu di'fayni wa kaana dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseeraa
Wa man yaqnut minkunna Lillaahi wa rasoolihi wa ta'mal saalihan nu'tihaa ajrahaa marratayni wa a'tadnaa lahaa rizqan kareemaa
Yaa nisaa'an-nabiyyi lastunna ka'ahadin minan-nisaa init-taqaytunna falaa takhda'na bil-qawli fayatma'al-ladhee fee qalbihi maradun wa qulna qawlan ma'roofaa

Wa qarna fee buyootikunna wa laa tabarrajna tabarrujal-jaahiliyyatil-oolaa wa aqimnas-salaata wa aateenaz-zakaata wa ati'na Allaaha wa rasoolahu innamaa yureedu Allaahu liyudhhiba ankumur-rijsa ahlal-bayti wa yutahhirakum tatheeraa
Wadhkurna maa yutlaa fee buyootikunna min aayaati Allaahi wal-hikmati innallaaha kaana lateefan khabeeraa

Innal-muslimeena wal-muslimaati wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati wal-qaaniteena wal-qaanitaati was-saadiqeena was-saadiqaati was-saabireena was-saabiraati wal-khaashi'eena wal-khaashi'aati wal-mutasaddiqeena wal-mutasaddiqaati was-saa'imeena was-saa'imaati wal-haafizeena furoojahum wal-haafizaati wadh-dhaakireena Allaaha katheeran wadh-dhaakiraati a'adda Allaahu lahum maghfiratan wa ajran azeemaa
Wa maa kaana limu'minin wa laa mu'minatin idhaa qadaa Allaahu wa rasooluhu amran an yakoona lahumul-khiyaratu min amrihim wa man ya'si Allaaha wa rasoolahu faqad dalla dalaalan mubeenaa

Wa idh taqoolu lilladhee an'ama Allaahu alayhi wa an'amta alayhi amsik alayka zawjaka wattaqi Allaaha wa tukhfee fee nafsika maa Allaahu mubdeehi wa takhshan-naasa Wallaahu ahaqqu an takhshaahu falammaa qadaa zaydun minhaa wataran zawwajnaakahaa likay laa yakoona alal-mu'mineena harajun fee azwaaji ad'iyaa'ihim idhaa qadaw minhunna wataran wa kaana amru Allaahi maf'oolaa
Maa kaana alan-nabiyyi min harajin feemaa farada Allaahu lahu sunnata Allaahi fil-ladheena khalaw min qablu wa kaana amru Allaahi qadaran maqdooraa
Al-ladheena yuballighoona risaalaati Allaahi wa yakhshawnahu wa laa yakhshawna ahadan illaa Allaaha wa kafaa Billaahi haseebaa
Maa kaana muhammadun abaa ahadin min rijaalikum wa laakin rasoola Allaahi wa khaataman-nabiyyeena wa kaana Allaahu bikulli shay'in aleemaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo udhkuroo Allaaha dhikran katheeraa
Wa sabbihoohu bukratan wa aseelaa
Huwal-ladhee yusallee alaykum wa malaa'ikatuhu liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori wa kaana bil-mu'mineena Raheemaa
Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salaamun wa a'adda lahum ajran kareemaa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa arsalnaaka shaahidan wa mubashshiran wa nadheeraa
Wa daa'eean ilaa Allaahi bi-idhnihi wa siraajan muneeraa
Wa bashshiril-mu'mineena bi-anna lahum mina Allaahi fadlan kabeeraa
Wa laa tuti'il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeena wa da adhaahum wa tawakkal alaa Allaahi wa kafaa Billaahi wakeelaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa nakahtumul-mu'minaati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna famaa lakum alayhinna min iddatin ta'taddoonahaa famatti'oohunna wa sarrihoohunna saraahan jameelaa

Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa ahlalnaa laka azwaajakal-laatee aatayta ujoorahunna wa maa malakat yameenuka mimmaa afaa'a Allaahu alayka wa banaati ammika wa banaati ammaatika wa banaati khaalika wa banaati khaalaatikal-laatee haajarna ma'aka wamra'atan mu'minatan in wahabat nafsahaa lin-nabiyyi in araadan-nabiyyu an yastankihahaa khaalisatan laka min doonil-mu'mineena qad alimnaa maa faradnaa alayhim fee azwaajihim wa maa malakat aymaanuhum likaylaa yakoona alayka harajun wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa

Turjee man tashaa'u minhunna wa tu'uwee ilayka man tashaa'u wa manib-taghayta mimman azalta falaa junaaha alayka dhaalika adnaa an taqarra a'yunuhunna wa laa yahzanna wa yardayna bimaa aataytahunna kulluhunna Wallaahu ya'lamu maa fee quloobikum wa kaana Allaahu aleeman haleemaa
Laa yahillu lakan-nisaa min ba'du wa laa an tabaddala bihinna min azwaajin wa law a'jabaka husnuhunna illaa maa malakat yameenuka wa kaana Allaahu alaa kulli shay'in raqeebaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo buyootan-nabiyyi illaa an yu'udhana lakum ilaa ta'aamin ghayra naazireena inaahu wa laakin idhaa du'eetum fadkhuloo fa-idhaa ta'imtum fantashiroo wa laa musta'niseena lihadeethin inna dhaalikum kaana yu'udhin-nabiyya fayastahyi minkum Wallaahu laa yastahyi minal-haqqi wa idhaa sa'altumoohunna mataa'an faas'aloohunna min waraa'i hijaabin dhaalikum atharu liquloobikum wa quloobihinna wa maa kaana lakum an tu'udhoo rasoola Allaahi wa laa an tankihoo azwaajahu min ba'dihi abadan inna dhaalikum kaana indallaahi azeemaa
In tubdoo shay'an aw tukhfoohu fa-innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in aleemaa

Laa junaaha alayhinna fee aabaa'ihinna wa laa abnaa'ihinna wa laa ikhwaanihinna wa laa abnaa'i ikhwaanihinna wa laa abnaa'i akhawaatihinna wa laa nisaa'ihinna wa laa maa malakat aymaanuhunna wattaqeena Allaaha innallaaha kaana alaa kulli shay'in shaheedaa
Innallaaha wa malaa'ikatahu yusalloona alan-nabiyyi yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo salloo alayhi wa sallimoo tasleemaa
Innal-ladheena yu'udhoona Allaaha wa rasoolahu la-anahumu Allaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa a'adda lahum adhaaban muheenaa
Wal-ladheena yu'udhoonal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati bighayri mak-tasaboo faqadi ihtamaloo buhtaanan wa ithman mubeenaa
Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'zwaajika wa banaatika wa nisaa'il-mu'mineena yudneena alayhinna min jalaabeebihinna dhaalika adnaa an yu'rafna falaa yu'udhayna wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa
La-in lam yantahil-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun wal-murjifoona fil-madeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma laa yujaawiroonaka feehaa illaa qaleelaa
Mal-ooneena aynamaa thuqifoo ukhidhoo wa quttiloo taqteelaa
Sunnata Allaahi fil-ladheena khalaw min qablu wa lan tajida lisunnati Allaahi tabdeelaa
Yas'alukan-naasu anis-saa'ati qul innamaa ilmuhaa indallaahi wa maa yudreeka la-allas-saa'ata takoonu qareebaa
Innallaaha la-anal-kaafireena wa a'adda lahum sa'eeraa
Khaalideena feehaa abadan laa yajidoona waliyyan wa laa naseeraa
Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fin-naari yaqooloona yaa laytanaa ata'naa Allaaha wa ata'nar-rasoolaa
Wa qaaloo rabbanaa innaa ata'naa saadatanaa wa kubaraa'anaa fa-adalloonas-sabeelaa
Rabbanaa aatihim di'fayni minal-adhaabi wal-anhum la'nan kabeeraa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena aadhaw moosaa fabarra'ahu Allaahu mimmaa qaaloo wa kaana indallaahi wajeehaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha wa qooloo qawlan sadeedaa
Yuslih lakum a'maalakum wa yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum wa man yuti'i Allaaha wa rasoolahu faqad faaza fawzan azeemaa
Innaa aradnal-amaanata alas-samaawaati wal-ardi wal-jibaali fa-abayna an yahmilnahaa wa ashfaqna minhaa wa hamalahal-insaanu innahu kaana zalooman jahoolaa
Liyu'adhdhiba Allaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-mushrikeena wal-mushrikaati wa yatooba Allaahu alal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa
